free_parameters.name: opset
free_parameters.why: a non-empty opset is required by the constructor; with max_nodes=0 no operator is actually inserted

free_parameters.name: init_rank
free_parameters.why: rank of the single initial placeholder; the target finalization branch does not depend on rank

free_parameters.name: max_nodes
free_parameters.why: zero generated ops: the target finalization branch runs after the generation loop, and this avoids the earlier per-op code that only handles values 0 and 1

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed makes graph generation and z3 parameter selection reproducible

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: generation budget bound; with max_nodes=0 the loop exits immediately, so this only guards against hangs
